# `Cratis.Chronicle.Contracts`
[🔗](https://github.com/Cratis/Chronicle/blob/main/lib/cratis/chronicle/contracts.ex#L4)

Generated Chronicle gRPC contracts for Elixir.

Generate the protobuf-backed stubs into `lib/generated` with
`generate-protos.sh`.
